coder_notes: Solid-tumour basket restricted to IDH1 R132 (or IDH2 for cholangiocarcinoma) mutant tumours. Glioma is in conditions but glioblastoma is named only in keywords (does not count, C7), and an IDH-mutant-only glioma population is not glioblastoma under CNS5, so not_glioblastoma. Roles by cohort: LY3410738 is monotherapy in escalation and expansion cohorts 1-3; with gemcitabine+cisplatin (cholangiocarcinoma backbone, soc_backbone) in cohort 4; with durvalumab in cohort 5 (both coded experimental_combination for that cohort, so LY3410738 is experimental_combination in cohort 5). Regimen coded combination because the expansion arm includes combination cohorts; monotherapy for escalation/cohorts 1-3. PK planned without sample type stated -> unclear; 2-HG in plasma is a target-engagement PD endpoint. IDH-mutant (not IDH-wildtype) entry requirement matched to the IDH inhibitor LY3410738 (mechanism from drug_class_hint, not stated in record).
